summary: An unnamed casual contact (calls the owner "broski"/"fam") who sent over IMEI 356429104830832 on 2026-05-20 asking for a device value check. The owner ran it on sickw.com — iPhone XR 128GB Red, iCloud Lock ON, out of warranty, SIM-unlocked — and told him it was worthless with a cracked screen. He later got into the iCloud himself and reset the phone, and since then has been asking about screen repair so he can use it as a second phone "for my clients." As of 2026-06-02 he's waiting on a price quote and the Tallahassee shop address so he can calculate cost plus shipping; the last message is an unanswered "Hello 👋🏼".
